name: habenula-oss
//overrides: Load-bearing: pins the MCP SDK's zod to v3, matching the engine's zod-mcp alias. npm hoists contracts' zod v4 to the root, which would otherwise make the SDK's types v4-shaped and blow up engine typecheck with TS2589 (deep instantiation). Do not remove or bump without re-running `just engine-typecheck` on a clean `npm ci` tree.
//overrides-security: Load-bearing: patches four packages that miniflare and wrangler depend on at exact or caret-pinned versions, which a bump to those two cannot reach. wrangler 4.109.0 and later require @cloudflare/workers-types v5, while partyserver (a dependency of the Agents SDK) requires v4, so the Cloudflare packages cannot move until the Agents SDK does. Each entry is the patched release for a published advisory in undici, ws, sharp, and esbuild. npm only re-evaluates overrides on a clean tree: after changing them, delete node_modules and package-lock.json before `npm install`, or the old versions silently persist.
